children: Teamshares entered into a Preferred Stock Purchase Agreement to issue 225,000 shares of Series A Preferred Stock at $990 per share, raising $222.75 million. The perpetual, non-voting, non-convertible preferred carries a $1,000 liquidation preference and accrues dividends at 16.0% in cash or 18.0% in kind, with step-downs upon meeting financial tests. The company may issue up to an additional $75 million of the same series on identical terms. Proceeds are subject to customary restrictions and are intended to strengthen liquidity and support operations.
